start.title: [TODO:tr] Two Men
start.text:
[TODO:tr] Jesus speaks quietly to the crowd.
"There was a rich man, and a poor man."

turn_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Sit and Hear
turn_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Some warnings save the soul.
Return to the words.

luxury.title: [TODO:tr] Purple and Fine Linen
luxury.text:
[TODO:tr] Inside, the rich man feasts each day,
clothed in purple, glad and full.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] Your eyes drift past the door.

envy_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Look Wider
envy_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Wealth is not the whole story.
There is more beyond the door.

gate.title: [TODO:tr] At the Gate
gate.text:
[TODO:tr] Lazarus lies at the gate, covered in sores.
He longs for the crumbs.

step_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Do Not Pass
step_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Every face is a gate of heaven.
Return to him.

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] No Judgment
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] You are not the judge of him.
You are the neighbor.

dogs.title: [TODO:tr] Only the Dogs
dogs.text:
[TODO:tr] Even the stray dogs come near
to lick his open wounds.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Stay with him in his pain

disgust_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Do Not Turn
disgust_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Mercy looks at what hurts.
Stay near him.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Stay with him in his pain

indifference.title: [TODO:tr] The Rich Man Passes
indifference.text:
[TODO:tr] The rich man crosses his gate each day.
He does not see Lazarus.

excuse_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] No Excuse
excuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] He had eyes. He had gold.
He had no compassion.

death_lazarus.title: [TODO:tr] Carried by Angels
death_lazarus.text:
[TODO:tr] Lazarus dies. Angels lift him
gently to Abraham's side.

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] He Is Seen
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The world forgot him.
Heaven never did.

death_rich.title: [TODO:tr] Buried in Torment
death_rich.text:
[TODO:tr] The rich man also dies.
He wakes in fire, in agony.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Be Sobered
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Tomorrow's gate may be your own.
Receive the warning.

pity_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Let It Teach You
pity_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Do not only feel sad.
Feel what your life must become.

plea.title: [TODO:tr] Send Lazarus
plea.text:
[TODO:tr] "Father Abraham, have mercy.
Send Lazarus, just one drop."

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Listen First
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The time to choose was before.
Hear what Abraham must say.

warning.title: [TODO:tr] Warn My Brothers
warning.text:
[TODO:tr] "Send him to my five brothers.
Let them not come to this place."

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Wait for a sign from the dead

sign_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] You Have the Word
sign_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] If you ignore the Scriptures,
no wonder will move you.

blame_god_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] He Has Spoken
blame_god_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The word has been given long ago.
The question is whether you obey.

ending.title: [TODO:tr] Open Your Gate
ending.text:
[TODO:tr] Jesus looks straight at you.
"Today, who lies at your gate?"
